description_en: Pushes a file to the cloud for detection
name: CreateFileDetect

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of file to detect. Valid values:

0: malicious file detection
parameters.help_zh:
需要检测的文件类型。取值：

0：恶意文件检测
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the file. This parameter is required and must be the MD5 or SHA-256 of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件唯一标识。此参数必填，且必须为文件的MD5或SHA-256
parameters.name: hash_key

parameters.help_en:
The storage key of the file in the OSS bucket.

If you push the file for detection by using DownloadUrl, this parameter is optional. This parameter is obtained from the [CreateFileDetectUploadUrl](~~CreateFileDetectUploadUrl~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
文件在OSS Bucket中的存储key。

如果通过DownloadUrl推送文件检测，此参数可不填。此参数通过[CreateFileDetectUploadUrl](~~CreateFileDetectUploadUrl~~)接口获取
parameters.name: oss_key

parameters.help_en: The download URL of the file. You can pass in a file download URL (public URL) to directly trigger file detection without uploading the file in advance
parameters.help_zh: 文件下载链接。支持传入文件下载链接（公网URL）直接触发文件检测，不需要提前上传文件
parameters.name: download_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to identify and decompress compressed files. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否识别压缩包并解压。取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: decompress

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of decompression layers when compressed files are nested within a compressed package. Maximum value: 5.

This parameter is required when Decompress is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
当压缩包内，存在多个层级的压缩包嵌套时，解压的最大解压层数。最大取值为5。

Decompress设置为true时，此参数不可为空
parameters.name: decompress_max_layer

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of files to decompress. Maximum value: 1000.

This parameter is required when Decompress is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
解压的最大文件数。最大取值为1000。

Decompress设置为true时，此参数不可为空
parameters.name: decompress_max_file_count

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
